title: Knowledge graph L1: Indicator
description: A programme indicator defined normatively at L1. Distinct from the DAK's ProgramIndicator component, which is its L2 expression; that model already carries `references 0..* id` pointing at health intervention ids. Corresponds to ProgramIndicator: same element names and types (markdown), identifier = ProgramIndicator.id; not a Parent because ProgramIndicator makes name, definition, numerator, denominator and disaggregation 1..1 and an L1 indicator is recorded with what its source states. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/indicator.
